item.title: Multimodal cell foundation models require synergistic integration beyond alignment
item.content:encoded:
Nature Machine Intelligence, Published online: 09 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s42256-026-01328-3

Richter et al. show that simply aligning different types of biological data does not fully integrate them, revealing when data repeat the same information and, conversely, when they provide complementary insights.
